name: add_primitive_object
description: G-2: a Blank pipeline project (F-2) gets a shape without an asset. Add Object > Cube sends one spawn of engine://primitives/cube; the Outliner shows Cube and selects it, and the Inspector's model field reads the primitive. Add material pass... (G-1, Create missing targets) adds a Forward opaque pass; the Blank pipeline has no pass for deferred materials and the primitive's default grey is automatic, so the form offers the forward default (G-4), checked, Save carries it with the pass and Studio restarts the engine on the same project. present reading the pass's output (F-6) through the Blank pipeline's engine://passthrough (VI-2), with no shader written, then puts a grey box on screen. A second Cube is named Cube_001.
